body:
Rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-14 09:05Z), learned on w-70ed: a focused registered check meant to earn a Test or Build record must run in the supported FOREGROUND form. Never use `--detach` with `focused`.

The host refuses it with "Unsupported focused launcher form with --detach: '--detach is not a foreground focused check; no Test or Build record will follow; use supported foreground launcher options.'" (d50d's test-438e8f8d). Such a run is diagnostic only and is not a qualifying run, so one corrected foreground run afterwards is NOT a "second run for the record".

Also, while a registered check runs, write nothing to its item: no status note, no claim renewal that changes work_revision, no rename. Those writes can invalidate the verification. Record afterwards.

Only `full` uses background or --detach, per CLAUDE.md, and only with the watcher-free rule.
